modelspec.diagram.EndpointRole.title: EndpointRole
modelspec.diagram.EndpointRole.description: What an Endpoint node stands for in a pipeline view (DESIGN.md § 13.4). The parameters' next state version is a sink, not an edge back to the Parameters stage, so every view is acyclic. CheckpointSink is the parameters' next version in Train, CheckpointSource the checkpoint Infer reads, PredictionSink the forward output `infer` writes.
